confidence: High for the 10 media-posting accounts (true_river921, north_ember718, true_ranger65, lazy_patriot930, local_fox863, mellow_ranger534, quiet_atlas278, real_atlas225, blue_otter565, lazy_pixel298): three independent producers (FKG fingerprint, account metadata/repost graph, fact-check matches) agree. Medium-high for the 2 text-only amplifiers (real_river38, lazy_river856): no media of their own, membership rests on creation date and 100% in-group reposting plus campaign-text posts.
evidence_summary: All 12 accounts were created 2026-09-10..09-13, a burst of 13 new accounts just before the first post in the dataset (2026-09-12); the 13th (mellow_comet121) behaves normally. Between 2026-10-03 and 10-05 the 10 media accounts posted ~30 posts pushing three False-rated claims (dam opened on purpose, mayor fled by private plane, relief centres refuse people without ID), nearly all with images the FKG rates Manipulated. Those images share one processing TTP: Resampling (scale ~0.75-0.86) -> GaussianBlur (sigma ~0.55-0.67) -> GaussianNoise (sigma ~1.03-1.30), usually attributed to FLUX.1 [dev] (sometimes misattributed to FLUX.1 [schnell]/Midjourney, or with one op missed). Pairwise matching (>=2 op types, params within 15%) links each to 12-16 other accounts. The fingerprint holds at 10%, 15% and 25% tolerance. The 12 accounts repost only each other (real_river38 9/9, lazy_river856 7/7, others 2-5 of 2-5 reposts), mostly within 0.5-6 h, and mix in camouflage posts ('Praying for everyone in Brennerton'). Provenance shows campaign images re-uploaded by ordinary users (lazy_pixel298 -> urban_falcon521, quiet_atlas278 -> wild_ranger624). The claim matcher missed some campaign posts (e.g. north_ember718's 'Mayor left by private plane...', both of lazy_river856's posts).
alternative_explanations_ruled_out: (1) 'Manipulated images are just common': ~295 of 648 images are AI-generated, posted by ordinary users with captions like 'Made this with an AI tool'. 4 manipulated images even sit on posts matched to the TRUE rain claim, so a Manipulated verdict alone is not evidence. (2) A second coordinated cluster exists, but it is commercial: 6 accounts created 2020-2023 post 'Aurora Trail' marketing with their own GPT-Image-1 Resampling(~0.5)->Sharpening(~0.8) fingerprint, and none of it matches a false claim. (3) Ordinary users who re-shared campaign images (rusty_harbor678, wild_ranger624, local_patriot982, sunny_willow249, wild_ranger20, urban_falcon521) carry the fingerprint. But each has one such post, hedged or questioning text ('Need answers', 'Is it true...?'), older accounts, and no in-group reposting. That is organic spread, consistent with provenance re-upload links. (4) The tap-water False claim (13 posts, 9 accounts, 2026-09-25..30) has mixed-age accounts, mostly text-only or Authentic images, a single unrelated manipulated image, and zero reposts. It reads as an organic rumor, not a media-driven operation. (5) Identical texts across accounts are not evidence alone: benign phrases ('Sunset from the roof.') are shared by 50+ ordinary accounts. (6) The other new accounts (mellow_comet121, quiet_maple931, brave_river882, sunny_river215, north_fox971) show no fingerprint and no in-group amplification.
criteria_used_by_detector: Flag ?account if A OR B. A (forensic TTP): >=2 of the account's own posts are matched to a claim whose rating is in the bottom 25% of its scale and carry an FKG-Manipulated image; the regions of those images share >=2 parameterised post-processing op types (same parameter name, values within 15% relative, NoPostProc excluded) with false-claim manipulated images from >=3 other accounts. B (behavioural): the account was created <=30 days before the dataset's first post, made >=3 reposts, >=80% of its reposts target posts by other accounts created in that same window, and >=2 posts it authored or reposted are matched to bottom-quartile-rated claims. No IRIs, texts, generator names or dates are hard-coded (the time window is relative to the data's first post).
